title: BV Poincaré inequality on Q_δ in double-integral form, by mollification and Fatou (parent step 5)
statement: Let m ∈ ℕ, Q₁ := {y ∈ Euclid (m + 1) : 0 < y_i < 1 for all i}, Q_δ := {y : δ < y_i < 1 − δ for all i}, u integrable on Q₁ and V ∈ ℝ satisfying (H): ∫_{Q₁} u·div g ≤ V for every C^∞ g with compact support, tsupport g ⊆ Q₁, |g| ≤ 1. Let 0 < δ < 1/2 and let (η_k)_{k∈ℕ} be C^∞ functions with compact support, η_k ≥ 0, η_k(−z) = η_k(z), ∫η_k = 1, support η_k ⊆ B(0, δ), such that η_k∗(1_{Q₁}u) → 1_{Q₁}u almost everywhere. Then ∫_{Q_δ} ∫_{Q_δ} |u(x) − u(y)| dy dx ≤ (m + 1)·(1 − 2δ)·volume(Q_δ)·V.
lean_statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (u : Euclid (m + 1) → ℝ) (V δ : ℝ) (η : ℕ → Euclid (m + 1) → ℝ), IntegrableOn u {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1} → (∀ g : Euclid (m + 1) → Euclid (m + 1), ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) g → HasCompactSupport g → tsupport g ⊆ {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1} → (∀ y, ‖g y‖ ≤ 1) → ∫ y in {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1}, u y * LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid (m + 1)) (fderiv ℝ g y) ≤ V) → 0 < δ → δ < 1 / 2 → (∀ k, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (η k)) → (∀ k, HasCompactSupport (η k)) → (∀ k z, 0 ≤ η k z) → (∀ k z, η k (-z) = η k z) → (∀ k, ∫ z, η k z = 1) → (∀ k, support (η k) ⊆ ball (0 : Euclid (m + 1)) δ) → (∀ᵐ x ∂volume, Tendsto (fun k => (convolution (η k) (Set.indicator {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1} u) (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) volume) x) atTop (𝓝 ((Set.indicator {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1} u) x))) → ∫ x in {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, δ < y i ∧ y i < 1 - δ}, ∫ y in {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, δ < y i ∧ y i < 1 - δ}, |u x - u y| ≤ ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (1 - 2 * δ) * (volume {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, δ < y i ∧ y i < 1 - δ}).toReal * V
